// How test/fixtures/recharts-3.10.1-ticks.json was recorded (2026-09-30), kept as text because it
// cannot run here: Recharts is no longer installed. To record again, in a scratch checkout:
//
//   pnpm add -D recharts@3.10.1
//   cp test/fixtures/recharts-3.10.1-ticks.recorder.txt src/components/charts/record.test.ts
//   pnpm exec vitest run --project page src/components/charts/record.test.ts
//
// and copy the JSON back. The two generators below are the ones in `time-ticks.test.ts` (seed 96)
// and `magnitude-ticks.test.ts` (seed 118), call for call: `preserveEnd[run]` and the
// "lo,hi,count" keys only mean anything while the tests draw the same numbers in the same order.
// Change a generator there and this file together, and record again.
import { writeFileSync } from "node:fs";
import path from "node:path";
import type { getTicks as GetTicks } from "recharts/types/cartesian/getTicks";
import { expect, it, vi } from "vitest";

// Recharts measures a label in the DOM; here its width is whatever the case says.
const widths = new Map<string, number>();
vi.mock("recharts/es6/util/DOMUtils", async (original) => ({
  ...(await original<object>()),
  getStringSize: (text: string) => ({ width: widths.get(text) ?? 0, height: 12 }),
}));
const { getTicks } = (await import("recharts/es6/cartesian/getTicks" as string)) as { getTicks: typeof GetTicks };
const { getTickValuesFixedDomain } = (await import("recharts/es6/util/scale/getNiceTickValues" as string)) as {
  getTickValuesFixedDomain: (domain: [number, number], tickCount: number, allowDecimals?: boolean) => number[];
};

const tenths = (v: number) => Math.abs(v * 10 - Math.round(v * 10)) < 1e-9;

it("records", () => {
  // `getTicks` with interval "preserveEnd": the values it keeps, for each of 300 cases.
  let seed = 96;
  let rand = () => (seed = (seed * 1103515245 + 12345) % 2 ** 31) / 2 ** 31;
  const preserveEnd: string[] = [];
  for (let run = 0; run < 300; run++) {
    const end = 200 + Math.floor(rand() * 900);
    const n = 1 + Math.floor(rand() * 80);
    const at = new Map<number, number>();
    widths.clear();
    const candidates = Array.from({ length: n }, (_, i) => {
      at.set(i, -30 + rand() * (end + 60));
      widths.set(`L${i}`, 20 + rand() * 70);
      return i;
    });
    if (n >= 2 && at.get(0)! >= at.get(1)!) at.set(1, at.get(0)! + 1 + rand() * 50);
    const gap = Math.floor(rand() * 60);
    const kept = getTicks({
      ticks: candidates.map((v, index) => ({ value: v, coordinate: at.get(v)!, index })),
      tick: true,
      tickFormatter: (v: number) => `L${v}`,
      viewBox: { x: 0, y: 0, width: end, height: 300 },
      minTickGap: gap,
      orientation: "bottom",
      interval: "preserveEnd",
    }).map((t) => t.value);
    preserveEnd.push(kept.join(","));
  }

  // `getTickValuesFixedDomain`: every one of 2000 domains where it gave whole tenths, which is
  // where `magnitudeTicks` must agree with it.
  seed = 118;
  rand = () => (seed = (seed * 1103515245 + 12345) % 2 ** 31) / 2 ** 31;
  const fixedDomain: Record<string, string> = {};
  for (let run = 0; run < 2000; run++) {
    const lo = Math.round(rand() * 40) / 10;
    const hi = Math.round((lo + rand() * 60) * 10) / 10;
    const count = 2 + Math.floor(rand() * 10);
    const ticks = getTickValuesFixedDomain([lo, hi], count, true);
    if (ticks.every(tenths)) fixedDomain[`${lo},${hi},${count}`] = ticks.join(",");
  }

  // Where it did not: the two domains `magnitude-ticks.test.ts` names as the reason for our rule.
  const offTenths = Object.fromEntries(
    (
      [
        [0.8, 7.4, 8],
        [2, 2.6, 8],
      ] as const
    ).map(([lo, hi, count]) => [`${lo},${hi},${count}`, getTickValuesFixedDomain([lo, hi], count, true).join(",")]),
  );

  expect(preserveEnd.length).toBe(300);
  writeFileSync(
    path.resolve(import.meta.dirname, "../../../test/fixtures/recharts-3.10.1-ticks.json"),
    JSON.stringify({ preserveEnd, fixedDomain, offTenths }, null, 1) + "\n",
  );
});
